Definition: from G2407; the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order (figuratively):--priesthood.
BiblicalUsage: hieráteuma means priesthood. It turns up twice, in 1 Peter.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hieráteuma plainly: priesthood, and I leave it there.
